ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 90% dark gray/black with 10% high-intensity white detail concentrated in localized scars and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary ground is a contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black region. High-contrast white pixels are mapped as thin, linear features (abrasions) and small, circular focal spots (scars) randomly distributed across the entire 2D fluke surface, with no macro-scale geometric white pigmentation blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary trailing edge. Notable macro-topographic anomaly present as a significant jagged indentation/notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep towards the distal tips, which are sharply pointed and oriented upwards relative to the central fluke axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5% to 2% of fluke area) concentrated heavily on the right lobe and near the distal tips, characteristic of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) varying in length and thickness, most prominent on the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch or tissue deficit on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Distinctive white-on-black horizontal parallel line scarring ('ladder' pattern) on the upper right lobe. High-intensity calcified clusters (barnacles) visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of three distinct, vertically stacked horizontal rake marks on the upper right lobe, adjacent to the trailing edge notch.
